findings.source_passage: Are the green fields gone? What do they here?... They must get just as nigh the water as they possibly can without falling in. And there they stand—miles of them—leagues.
findings.why_it_matters: The cascade of rhetorical questions and the 'miles of them—leagues' amplification is part of the voice-establishing opening; the draft collapses two paragraphs into one sentence and loses the incantatory build.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore at least 'Are the green fields gone?' and the 'miles of them—leagues' cadence to preserve the rhetorical pressure.

findings.source_passage: Why did the poor poet of Tennessee, upon suddenly receiving two handfuls of silver, deliberate whether to buy him a coat... or invest his money in a pedestrian trip to Rockaway Beach?
findings.why_it_matters: The plan explicitly flags the Tennessee-poet passage as one of the rhetorical-question cascade entries whose cumulative pressure IS the voice; the draft drops it entirely along with 'first voyage as a passenger... mystical vibration.' The cascade is thinned from six questions to three.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore at least the Tennessee poet question and the 'first voyage as a passenger... mystical vibration' question to preserve the cascade's accumulation.

findings.source_passage: The urbane activity with which a man receives money is really marvellous, considering that we so earnestly believe money to be the root of all earthly ills... Ah! how cheerfully we consign ourselves to perdition!
findings.why_it_matters: The 'cheerfully we consign ourselves to perdition' climax is a signature Ishmaelian ironic flourish that closes the paying meditation; without it the joke is set up but not paid off.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'urbane activity... root of all earthly ills... cheerfully we consign ourselves to perdition!' close to complete the ironic arc.

findings.source_passage: head winds are far more prevalent than winds from astern... the Commodore on the quarter-deck gets his atmosphere at second hand from the sailors on the forecastle... the commonalty lead their leaders
findings.why_it_matters: The 'commonalty lead their leaders' conceit complements 'Who ain't a slave?' as part of Ishmael's democratic ethic; its loss is a minor thematic thinning.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider a brief retention of the head-winds / commonalty-leads-leaders conceit.

summary: Major signatures (opening, Cato/pistol, Narcissus key, Who ain't a slave, playbill, itch for things remote, snow hill) are preserved verbatim; the rhetorical-question cascade and the 'cheerfully we consign ourselves to perdition' flourish are thinned, but not to the point of triggering regeneration.
